svg.text: Figure 2 · Where every number on a sheet comes from
Each field of a sheet traced to the value and the file it is drawn from. The metrics and the sheets are written by the same CAD run (tools/cad/make.sh), so a sheet that differs
UAV in blue, person in grey
Generated by tools/figures/drawings_readme.py from the drawing sheets, cad/metrics.json and tools/cad/drawings.py. Concept layouts for review: placeholder geometry, not a design, not for manufacture.

g.text: Terms: CAD = computer-aided design · CG = centre of gravity · FreeCAD = open-source parametric CAD program used for the concept layouts · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
